run_gtest_list_tests: run the googletest-list-tests-unittest_ executable with args and return the printed list of tests
test_gtest_list_tests_flag: test the --gtest_list_tests flag by running the executable and verifying output matches expected regex
test_gtest_list_tests_default: test the default behavior when --gtest_list_tests flag is not set
test_gtest_list_tests_with_filter: test that --gtest_list_tests respects the --gtest_filter flag for filtering test names
test_gtest_list_tests_override: test that --gtest_list_tests overrides non-filter flags like --gtest_break_on_failure
